## File: facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/fairseq/models/speech_to_text/berard.py

Prompts

```
['build a s2t_berard speech-to-text translation model with a bi-LSTM encoder and LSTM decoder', 'build a BerardEncoder with linear input layers, conv2d layers, and bidirectional LSTM layers', 'build an LSTMDecoder with Bahdanau MLP attention for incremental speech-to-text decoding', 'build an MLPAttention module that computes Bahdanau attention scores between encoder and decoder states', 'configure a s2t_berard model architecture with default hyperparameters for speech translation', 'build a speech-to-text transformer model with Conv1dSubsampler encoder and TransformerDecoder for ASR tasks', 'create a Conv1dSubsampler module that downsamples audio features using stacked 1D convolutions with GLU activation', 'build an S2TTransformerEncoder that combines a convolutional subsampler with Transformer encoder layers for speech input', 'configure s2t_transformer architecture variants (s/m/l) with preset encoder dimensions, attention heads, and dropout rates', 'run the S2TTransformerModel forward pass with source tokens, lengths, and previous output tokens for inference']
```

Usage

```
{'build_berard_model': 'build a s2t_berard speech-to-text translation model with a bi-LSTM encoder and LSTM decoder', 'build_berard_encoder': 'build a BerardEncoder with linear input layers, conv2d layers, and bidirectional LSTM layers', 'build_lstm_decoder': 'build an LSTMDecoder with Bahdanau MLP attention for incremental speech-to-text decoding', 'build_mlp_attention': 'build an MLPAttention module that computes Bahdanau attention scores between encoder and decoder states', 'configure_berard_architecture': 'configure a s2t_berard model architecture with default hyperparameters for speech translation'}
```
